{{Quote|War is in our blood. Violence against us is not smart.|Murthil|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
'''Murthil''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was known as a vicious warrior, and came to be the [[den mother]] of Selonians who lived inside the [[Selonian Tunnels|Selonian Tunnel Network]] under Corellia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].

==Biography==
When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[den mother]] Murthil, along with her [[Murthil's den|den's]] many Selonians, aided the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] rebels in their battle against the Imperials. After the Empire bombed several factories in the [[Labor Valley]], Murthil led a group of rebel Selonians when the Empire placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on them in an effort to cull the aliens' numbers. Afterwards, the Selonians traveled to a tunnel network underneath [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] where they faced an Imperial hero who had followed them. Murthil and her troops including [[Destha]] battled the Imperials, but were all defeated. By the time [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hesker]] and his men entered the scene, Murthil was the only one left alive and pleading to spare her in exchange for joining the Empire.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Domesticate the Selonians or kill them, may the dark side guide you.|Darth Decimus, to the player|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
Murthil is a character in the 2011 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game. Depending on the choices the player(s)' make, Murthil is either sworn to serve the Empire (light side option) or is executed along with the rest of her species (dark side option).
